heading: T_wcet impact
text:
## T_wcet impact [LCAP.4]

Let the base T_wcet formula be:

```
T_base = T_alpha + T_beta(N_max) + T_tms(n_ids) + T_agenda(log A)
       + T_fire(F_max × A_max × E_rhs)
       + T_ttl(expired × log n_ttl_schemas + n_ttl_schemas)
```

Each setting's effect on this formula:

| Setting | Term affected | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `realtime: true` | All | Bounds every parameter; N_max, n_ids ≤ 16, A ≤ token_pool_cap. Formula becomes finite. |
| `linear_scan: false` | T_beta | O(N_max × T_j) → O(1); J_max=1 proven. |
| `linear_scan: false` | T_alpha string tests | O(len) → O(capacity) = O(1) via LNLS.3.10 |
| `logical: false` | T_tms | c_tms × n_ids → 0 (TMS absent) |
| `logical: false` | T_retract cascade | No cascade depth multiplier |
| `dynamic_ttl: true` | T_ttl | FIFO, no term in N_ttl → heap O(expired × log N_ttl) |

Under `realtime: true, linear_scan: false` (with `dynamic_ttl: false`,
`logical: true`):

```
T_wcet = c_alpha × Σ_s(α_s × T_s)        ← all O(1) per LNLS.3.10
       + c_join  × F_max                  ← O(1) per join, J_max=1
       + c_tms   × 16                     ← constant (rt_locked)
       + c_agenda × F_max × log F_max     ← agenda heap
       + c_fire  × F_max × A_max × E_rhs  ← RHS evaluation
       + c_ttl   × (max_expired × log n_schemas + n_schemas)  ← FIFO constant
```

**All parameters are compile-time constants.**  T_wcet is a fixed number.

Adding `logical: false`:
— same formula, T_tms term = 0.  Retract has no cascade.

Adding `dynamic_ttl: true` instead:
— T_ttl = c_heap × expired × log N_ttl.  This term grows with N_max
(via expired_max ∝ N_max / min_ttl).  T_wcet is no longer O(1) in N_max.
